About Us
Vision Life Ministries Ltd is a Christ-Centered Ministry Based in Uganda, Committed To Preaching The Gospel of Jesus Christ And Transforming Lives Through Love, Faith, And Practical Support. Established With A Passion To Fulfill The Great Commission, Vision Life Ministries Reaches Out To People With The Message Of Salvation, Conducts Revival Meetings, Seminars, Crusades, And Christian Camps, And Establishes Churches In Various Localities To Expand God's Kingdom. We Are Dedicated To Identifying, Equipping, And Empowering People's God-Given Talents And Abilities For Personal Growth, Ministry Effectiveness, And Community Transformation.
